signing.rsa_public_exponent: odd integer greater than or equal to 3

lifetime.refresh_model: issue a new short-lived service credential; do not extend an existing token

security_requirements: private signing keys never leave GoreeCloud Identity
caller-selected arbitrary service identities are prohibited
each token audience must be explicitly registered in this contract
each service id must be explicitly approved for the target audience
requested scopes must be a subset of both Identity-authenticated principal grants and the target audience policy
consumers must validate signature, protected-header profile, issuer, exact audience, expiry, not-before, service identity, required scope, kid profile, RSA key strength, and RSA public exponent
tokens must not contain user content, prompts, Privacy Shield capability references, signed Privacy Shield capabilities, application data, session secrets, reusable passwords, or private key material
direct-service authentication does not itself create Privacy Shield authorization for an end-user data operation
the authenticated direct-service identity may only supply the service consumer identity required by the target service
unknown kid, unsupported audience, unapproved service id, unsupported scope, malformed claim, invalid temporal claim, or invalid key material must fail closed

privacy_shield_search_boundary.purpose: authenticate GoreeCloud Search as the service caller of the Privacy Shield capability-reference verification boundary

deployment_boundary: The native direct-service issuer and verifier are source implemented for the bounded GoreeCloud Search to Privacy Shield service-authentication profile. This does not create a deployed Identity issuer, JWKS endpoint, Privacy Shield authentication middleware, network transport, production signing-key custody, production requester authentication, or production acceptance.
